classification: research-only source patch; not applied to maintained WRF source and not runtime-validated
compile_status: Modified module compiles with pinned ifx; a manufactured O0/O2 routine-level same-operator test passes. Driver and coupled WRF runtime were not built.
open: Actual-runtime QI/QNI tendency capture at cell (133,2,1).
Authentication of DEL as the native dry carrier.
Exact upstream producer of first mass-only QI.
Scientific validation/conservation of coupled WRF physics.
operator_test_scope: QI and scaled QNI (2**30 times QI, within an ice PSD mean-mass interval) receive proportionally matched, nonzero tendencies; division of QNI tendency by 2**30 matches QI exactly with QNI alone and when NC occupies channel 4 and QNI channel 5 simultaneously. Both channels create a positive recipient tendency from zero initial values, and a 60 s update remains nonnegative. Optional output halos are zeroed. A supplied disabled QNI output and QNI enabled without the optional paired QI tendency are both fully zeroed after sentinel initialization.
source_contract: QNI is appended as the next available channel to the same Shinhong vertical operator that carries QI (channel 5 when NC is enabled, channel 4 otherwise).
QNI channel offset is channel-1 so base channels and the pre-existing NC fourth channel retain slots 1..4.
QNI is gated by availability of the paired QI tendency and a positive p_qni; generic scalar PBL path disables this update to avoid double mixing.
Optional QNI tendency output is initialized to zero when supplied but disabled.
